import chatretry


def test_cd01_compositional_resume_then_replay():
    assert chatretry.should_resume(True, 1) is True
    assert chatretry.replay(["a", "b", "c"], 1) == ["b", "c"]

import chatretry


def test_cd01_negative_clean_disconnect_stays_put():
    assert chatretry.should_resume(False, 1) is False
    assert chatretry.should_resume(True, -1) is False

import chatretry


def test_cd01_boundary_cursor_edges():
    assert chatretry.replay(["a", "b"], 0) == ["a", "b"]
    assert chatretry.replay(["a", "b"], 2) == []
